title: Demand spike investigation - SKU-003
content: Root cause: a regional promotional campaign in the US-East territory ran for 2 weeks, driving SKU-003 demand to roughly 3x the trailing 8-week average. Marketing confirmed the promotion; no data quality issue found. Recommend a temporary reorder-point increase until the promotion ends.

title: Demand drop investigation - SKU-005
content: Root cause: a competitor launched a directly competing product in EU-Central two weeks ago. Sales confirms several accounts have shifted purchasing to the competitor. Demand is not expected to recover without a pricing or marketing response.

title: Temporary stock-out - SKU-002 (resolved)
content: A carrier delay at the US-West distribution center caused a 4-day stock-out for SKU-002 last quarter. Resolved once the delayed shipment arrived; no ongoing demand anomaly.

title: Seasonal dip - SKU-001 (expected)
content: SKU-001 shows a predictable ~10% demand dip every year in this period due to seasonal buying patterns. This is expected and does not require investigation.

title: Warehouse management system migration - reporting note
content: The warehouse management system was migrated to a new vendor over a 2-week period company-wide. Some inventory reports during the migration window may have lagged by up to 24 hours. This is a data-quality note, not a demand anomaly.
